hook: What if you got paid to do what you love?
facts: In *1973*, researchers watched preschoolers who loved drawing with markers.
Some were promised a *certificate* for drawing. Others weren't.
Later, the promised-reward kids drew only *half* as much.
A *surprise* reward didn't cause this. Only the *promised* one did.
outro: Rewards can turn play into work.
title: Psychology Facts
